name: Exp_BBSqueeze
summary: This EA trades based on the BBSqueeze indicator, which detects Bollinger Band squeeze (low volatility) breakout conditions. It opens long positions when the upper histogram bar is non-empty and the previous lower bar confirms direction, and vice versa for shorts. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, with optional money management based on deposit share.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BBSqueeze指标进行交易，该指标检测布林带收缩（低波动率）后的突破条件。当上直方图柱非空且前一下方柱确认方向时开多头，反之开空头。持仓通过固定止损和止盈管理，并支持基于存款比例的资金管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于布林带收缩（Bollinger Band Squeeze）突破，即当市场波动率压缩到极低水平后预期将出现方向性突破。入场条件为：当BBSqueeze指标的上直方图值（UpValue）非空且不等于EMPTY_VALUE时，结合前一根柱的下直方图值（DnValue）确认，触发做多信号；反之，下直方图值非空时结合上直方图确认触发做空信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），盈亏比为2:1。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理由TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数处理，支持基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1（前一根已收盘K线）来避免未来数据偏差，具备新K线检测机制确保仅在K线收盘时计算信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Bollinger Band Squeeze breakout, which anticipates a directional move after market volatility compresses to extremely low levels. Entry conditions are: when the BBSqueeze indicator's upper histogram value (UpValue) is non-empty and not EMPTY_VALUE, combined with the previous bar's lower histogram value (DnValue) confirmation, a buy signal is triggered; conversely, when the lower histogram value is non-empty and confirmed by the upper histogram, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions rely on fixed Stop Loss (default 1000 points) and Take Profit (default 2000 points), yielding a reward-to-risk ratio of 2:1. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-share-based lot calculation. Money management is handled by functions in TradeAlgorithms.mqh, supporting dynamic position calculation based on account balance. The strategy defaults to the H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1 (the previous closed bar) to avoid look-ahead bias, with a new bar detection mechanism ensuring signals are only calculated at bar close.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易存款比例，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade deposit fraction, negative for fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格滑点偏差点数
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: BB_Method
parameters.description: 布林带直方图平滑方法

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 布林带收缩突破是经典且有统计学支撑的策略概念，低波动后高波动的转换具有较高的可预测性
使用SignalBar=1确保仅在K线收盘后生成信号，避免了未来数据回看偏差
具备完整的多空双向开关控制，允许灵活地只做多或只做空
2:1的盈亏比设计有利于长期正期望值
新K线检测机制避免了同根K线内重复计算和重复交易
pros_en: Bollinger Band squeeze breakout is a classic strategy concept with statistical support, as low-to-high volatility transitions are relatively predictable
Using SignalBar=1 ensures signals are generated only after bar close, avoiding look-ahead bias
Complete buy/sell toggle controls allow flexible directional trading (long-only, short-only, or both)
The 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio design supports long-term positive expectancy
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated calculations and duplicate trades within the same bar
cons: 没有移动止损或追踪止损功能，可能导致盈利大幅回撤后才由固定止盈出场
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在流动性差的时段可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点对于H4周期来说可能过大，在震荡市中容易触发止损
依赖外部自定义指标BBSqueeze，增加了部署复杂性和依赖风险
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
cons_en: No trailing stop functionality, which may cause significant profit drawdown before the fixed take profit is hit
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points may be excessive for H4, easily triggered in choppy markets
Depends on the external custom indicator BBSqueeze, increasing deployment complexity and dependency risk
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 增加追踪止损功能，在价格朝有利方向移动时锁定部分利润，提高策略的风险调整收益
添加持仓检查和最大持仓数限制，防止同方向重复开仓导致过度集中风险
improvements_en: Add a trailing stop feature to lock in partial profits when price moves favorably, improving risk-adjusted returns
Add position checking and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate directional entries and over-concentration risk

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，造成过度敞口
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能频繁止损
没有点差过滤，在点差扩大时仍会执行交易
risk_points_en: Lack of position checking may cause duplicate directional entries, creating excessive exposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to market volatility changes, potentially causing frequent stop-outs during high-volatility periods
No spread filter means trades execute even when spreads widen
